faq.question: Is my JSON data uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. All comparison happens in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faq.question: What types of differences does it detect?
faq.answer: It detects added keys, removed keys, changed values, and type changes between two JSON documents.

faq.question: Can I compare JSON files of different sizes?
faq.answer: Yes. The tool handles JSON documents of any size and structure. Differences are shown regardless of the documents' sizes.

faq.question: Does it support nested JSON objects?
faq.answer: Yes. The comparison is recursive and works with deeply nested JSON objects and arrays.

faq.question: Can I compare large JSON files?
faq.answer: Yes. Since all processing happens locally, file size is limited only by your browser's memory.

faq.question: Is this a free online JSON compare and diff tool?
faq.answer: Yes. This is a free json compare online and json diff online tool. You can compare json, spot every difference json has between two versions, and use it as an online json compare tool — all in your browser with no upload.

faq.question: 我的 JSON 数据会上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。所有比较在浏览器中完成，数据不会离开你的设备。

faq.question: 能检测哪些类型的差异？
faq.answer: 能检测新增的键、删除的键、值的变化以及两个 JSON 文档之间的类型变化。

faq.question: 可以比较不同大小的 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以。工具能处理任意大小和结构的 JSON 文档，会显示所有差异。

faq.question: 支持嵌套 JSON 对象吗？
faq.answer: 支持。比较是递归的，可以处理深度嵌套的 JSON 对象和数组。

faq.question: 可以比较大型 JSON 文件吗？
faq.answer: 可以。所有处理在本地完成，文件大小仅受浏览器内存限制。

faq.question: 这是一个在线json比较工具吗？
faq.answer: 是的。这是一个免费的在线json比较工具，支持比较json并高亮显示差异。无需上传数据，在浏览器中即可完成所有比较。
